verdict.rationale: Rootly documents API key generation and notes that 'Global API Keys are assigned an On-Call and Incident Response role when they're generated,' showing some role-based scoping exists for API credentials that could be used by an agent (rootly-docs-24, rootly-docs-49). However, there's no evidence of granular, per-agent least-privilege scoping (e.g., custom permission sets, resource-level restrictions, or multiple distinct scoped roles) beyond this single fixed role. Missing for 10: documentation of customizable/fine-grained permission scopes, ability to issue distinct scoped keys per agent/task, and any audit or revocation controls specific to agent credentials.
